candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit, allowing deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit.
Remove the overflow check require statement, making the deposit possible even when it would overflow balances.
Change balances update from += to assignment (=), overwriting instead of adding to the existing balance.
Delete the if-guard checking msg.value > MinDeposit, allowing all deposits regardless of value.
Insert a division of msg.value by 2 before adding to balances, so only half the sent value is credited.
